question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
-- Final query: Get all states where both M and F have retention > 0 at all 6 time points
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start, lt.term_end, lt.state, l.gender,
           CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS first_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
time_points AS (
    SELECT 0 AS years_after UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT ft.id_bioguide, ft.state, ft.gender, ft.first_year, tp.years_after,
           CAST(ft.first_year + tp.years_after AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS check_date
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN time_points tp
),
retained AS (
    SELECT rc.id_bioguide, rc.state, rc.gender, rc.years_after,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
               WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = rc.id_bioguide
               AND lt2.term_start <= rc.check_date
               AND lt2.term_end >= rc.check_date
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
    FROM retention_check rc
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT state, gender, years_after,
           COUNT(*) AS total,
           SUM(retained) AS retained_count,
           1.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*) AS retention_rate
    FROM retained
    GROUP BY state, gender, years_after
),
gender_valid AS (
    SELECT state, gender
    FROM retention_rates
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING MIN(retention_rate) > 0
       AND COUNT(*) = 6
),
valid_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM gender_valid
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
)
SELECT state
FROM valid_states
ORDER BY state

    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
time_points AS (
    SELECT 0 AS years_after UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT ft.id_bioguide, ft.state, ft.gender, ft.first_year, tp.years_after,
           CAST(ft.first_year + tp.years_after AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS check_date
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN time_points tp
),
retained AS (
    SELECT rc.id_bioguide, rc.state, rc.gender, rc.years_after,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
               WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = rc.id_bioguide
               AND lt2.term_start <= rc.check_date
               AND lt2.term_end >= rc.check_date
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
    FROM retention_check rc
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT state, gender, years_after,
           COUNT(*) AS total,
           SUM(retained) AS retained_count,
           1.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*) AS retention_rate
    FROM retained
    GROUP BY state, gender, years_after
),
gender_valid AS (

    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING MIN(retention_rate) > 0

    GROUP BY state
